an3.64:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an3.64:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sarabho nāma paribbājako acirapakkanto hoti imasmā dhammavinayā
an3.64:1.4: so rājagahe parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
an3.64:1.6: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti.
an3.64:1.7: athakho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
an3.64:1.8: assosuṃ kho te bhikkhū sarabhassa paribbājakassa rājagahe parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa
an3.64:1.10: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti.
an3.64:2.1: athakho te bhikkhū rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
an3.64:2.2: sarabho nāma bhante paribbājako acirapakkanto imasmā dhammavinayā
an3.64:2.3: so rājagahe parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
an3.64:2.5: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti
an3.64:2.6: sādhu bhante bhagavā yena sappiniyā tīraṃ paribbājakārāmo yena sarabho paribbājako tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an3.64:3.1: athakho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena sappiniyā tīraṃ paribbājakārāmo yena sarabho paribbājako tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi nisajja kho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca
an3.64:3.2: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ sarabha evaṃ vadesi
an3.64:3.4: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti.
an3.64:3.5: evaṃ vutte sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:4.1: dutiyampi kho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca
an3.64:4.2: vadehi sarabha kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo
an3.64:4.3: sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ paripūressāmi
an3.64:4.4: sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ anumodissāmīti.
an3.64:4.5: dutiyampi kho sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:5.1: tatiyampi kho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca
an3.64:5.2: mayā kho sarabha paññāyati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo vadehi sarabha kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo
an3.64:5.3: sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ paripūressāmi
an3.64:5.4: sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ anumodissāmīti.
an3.64:5.5: tatiyampi kho sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:6.1: athakho te paribbājakā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavocuṃ
an3.64:6.2: yadeva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ yāceyyāsi tadeva te samaṇo gotamo pavāreti
an3.64:6.3: vadehi āvuso sarabha kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo
an3.64:6.4: sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati samaṇo gotamo paripūressati
an3.64:6.5: sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati samaṇo gotamo anumodissatīti.
an3.64:6.6: evaṃ vutte sarabho paribbājako tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāṇo nisīdi.
an3.64:7.1: athakho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhāṇaṃ viditvā te paribbājake etadavoca
an3.64:8.1: yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya
an3.64:8.2: sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhāti tamahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanuggāheyyaṃ samanubhāseyyaṃ
an3.64:8.3: so vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissati tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāṇo nisīdissati seyyathāpi sarabho paribbājako
an3.64:9.1: yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya
an3.64:9.2: khīṇāsavassa te paṭijānato ime āsavā aparikkhīṇāti tamahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanuggāheyyaṃ samanubhāseyyaṃ
an3.64:9.3: so vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissati tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāṇo nisīdissati seyyathāpi sarabho paribbājako
an3.64:10.1: yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya
an3.64:10.2: yassa kho pana te atthāya dhammo desito so na niyyāti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyāti tamahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanuggāheyyaṃ samanubhāseyyaṃ
an3.64:10.3: so vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanuggāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissati tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāṇo nisīdissati seyyathāpi sarabho paribbājakoti.
an3.64:10.4: athakho bhagavā sappiniyā tīre paribbājakārāme tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā vehāsaṃ pakkāmi.
an3.64:11.1: athakho te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāya sannitodakena sañjambhariṃ akaṃsu
an3.64:11.2: seyyathāpi āvuso sarabha brahāraññe jarasigālo sīhanādaṃ nadissāmīti segālakaṃyeva nadati bheraṇḍakaṃyeva nadati
an3.64:11.3: evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha aññatreva samaṇena gotamena sīhanādaṃ nadissāmīti segālakaṃyeva nadasi bheraṇḍakaṃyeva nadasi
an3.64:11.4: seyyathāpi āvuso sarabha ambakamaddarī pussakaravitaṃ ravissāmīti ambakamaddarīravitaṃyeva ravati
an3.64:11.5: evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha aññatreva samaṇena gotamena pussakaravitaṃ ravissāmīti ambakamaddarīravitaṃyeva ravasi
an3.64:11.6: seyyathāpi āvuso sarabha usabho suññāya gosālāya gambhīraṃ naditabbaṃ maññati
an3.64:11.7: evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha aññatreva samaṇena gotamena gambhīraṃ naditabbaṃ maññasīti.
an3.64:11.8: athakho te paribbājakā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāya sannitodakena sañjambhariṃ
